title: Universally closed morphisms satisfy valuative existence
statement: Let $f:X\to Y$ be a universally closed morphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme, def-weil-proper-morphism]. Let $A$ be a valuation ring with fraction field $K$ [def-trf-valuation-ring]. For every pair of morphisms $u:\operatorname{Spec}K\to X$ and $v:\operatorname{Spec}A\to Y$ [def-weil-affine-spectrum] with $fu=vj$, where $j:\operatorname{Spec}K\to\operatorname{Spec}A$ is induced by $A\hookrightarrow K$, there exists $h:\operatorname{Spec}A\to X$ with $fh=v$ and $hj=u$. There is no separatedness or finite-type assumption on $f$, and uniqueness is not asserted.
